title: The Archive of Sector Nine Revisited
author: Juniper Dravenmoor
blurb: Jude Quintana, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
